The [[Kadri'Ra]] [[Saadoon-Kauldi]] created '''his own criminal empire''' after being released from [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. He based his power in alliance with other [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] such as [[Abdi-Badawzi]] and in a big number of former slaves who swore loyalty to Saadoon-Kauldi after being released.

==History==
[[Saadoon-Kauldi]], a [[Kadri'Ra]] and former [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], was released by the [[Badawzi family]] of [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and, after serving them for years and knowing about the respect an indentured servant could receive, he decided to leave and create his own criminal empire.<ref name="BS" />

A cultured, shrewd person, Saadoon-Kauldi used his natural skills and took control over pre-existing [[Spice/Legends|spice]] runs, [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowports]] and spice processing facilities. He hired a number of [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] and became an up-and-comer [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], earning the respect of his [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] peers. He had at least five thousand direct agents working in gambling; laundering; smuggling, including drug trade and gunrunning; and usury. In an uncommon movement, he decided to base his power in alliances with other criminals.<ref name="BS" />

During a smuggling run, Saadoon-Kauldi boarded a [[Galleon (Starship class)|galleon]] where several slaves were being mistreated by their masters. Saadoon-Kauldi [[Massacre on the galleon|killed the enslavers]] and released the slaves, but the slaves then swore loyalty and service to Saadoon-Kauldi. Saadoon-Kauldi, who had been mistreated as a slave, swore to respect his new servants.<ref name="BS" />

The Kadri'Ra also began an [[Saadoon-Kauldi's anti-slaver campaign|extended campaign]] in which all the resources of his incipient criminal empire would be temporarily redirected to the abduction of slaver starships with the goal of releasing a great number of slaves. After other attacks, including one [[Rescue at the Imperial garbage scow|releasing]] hundreds of slaves from an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Garbage scow/Legends|garbage scow]], Saadoon-Kauldi decided to end his personal crusade and return to drug dealing. At that point, the sheer number of emancipated ex-slaves had become Saadoon-Kauldi's most numerous ally.<ref name="BS" />

Due to the campaign, a [[slaver guild]] prompted the Empire to post a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Saadoon-Kauldi's head, and he had to face several [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts; the Empire also tried to enslave him again. The Kadri'Ra began to suffer from paranoia.<ref name="BS" />

Soon afterward, Saadoon-Kauldi was contacted by [[Abdi-Badawzi]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] crime lord controlling the Socorro system. Abdi-Badawzi wanted to create a partnership with Saadoon-Kauldi so that the Twi'lek could expand his territory into areas where the Kadri'Ra could protect him. Saadoon-Kauldi forged an alliance with Abdi-Badawzi and his several groups, including [[Ethra Brewery]] and [[Caelli-Merced Syndicate]]. He moved to Socorro and also allied with the [[Black Bha'lir]], operating from the orbit of [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]]. Eventually, Saadoon-Kauldi's criminal empire began sending weapons regularly to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="ABW">{{JournalCite|5|A Bitter Winter}}</ref>

Saadoon-Kauldi's criminal empire had a brush c. [[10 BBY/Legends|10 BBY]] when [[Saylor Marjan]] owed the Kadri'Ra some money. Saadoon-Kauldi sent [[Toob Ancher]] and [[Fahs Oxsor]] to collect, and the situation got worse.<ref name="ABW" />

C. [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Saadoon-Kauldi's criminal empire tried to recruit [[Drake Paulsen]], a young and promising piracy who was also courted by other groups. Paulsen eventually joined the Bha'lir. At that time, the organization's main criminal activities included credit laundering; gambling; illegal sale and delivery of controlled substances; loansharking and smuggling, including arms trafficking.<ref name="BS" />
